To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the FAME architecture provides multi-level user authentication to PERMIS, the X.509 based authorisation decision engine, via Shibboleth, the federated identity management system.

(1) FAME can provide multi-level user authentication for Shibboleth and can be used to provide a higher level of assurance than the current Shibboleth authentication service; (2) the FAME architecture can be used to extend the current authentication service of Shibboleth; (3) FAME is flexible in that it allows the user to choose the authentication method and the authentication token to use; (4) FAME can be used to support different authentication methods, such as password,

FAME is able to derive the authentication level of the user from the authentication token used and the authentication protocol used by the client and to provide it to the authorisation engine via Shibboleht, and thus to enable more fine grained access control to resources.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to use Shibboleth to provide a flexible authentication and authorisation service for a wide range of resources.

the design of FAM is very good.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed an architecture for multi-level user authentication for Shibboleth and we have demonstrated the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed architecture by implementing a proof of concept system.
we have developed and deployed a multi-factor authentication solution to Shibboleth that is able to provide the authentication assurance level (AAL) as a parameter to the PERMis authorisation engine.

we have developed a prototype system that can be deployed to provide multi-level authentication to Shibboleth, and we have evaluated the system by performing a number of tests to show that the FAME architecture is capable of providing the required functionality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is feasible to add multi-level authentication to Shibboleth without modifying its core components.

FAME provides a flexible and scalable architecture to support the deployment of multi-level authentication service in Shibboleth, and that the FAME architecture is capable of integrating a wide range of authentication methods and technologies.
the FAME architecture can be easily integrated with Shibboleth and other existing authentication and authorisation systems.
